constants.iHaveReadAndUnderstood: I have read and understood that charging through MASAV is based on the volume of activity on the platform and the fee rate set in the agreement, and therefore the bank authorization is required with no amount limit and no time limit.
constants.whyIsAnAuthorizationWith: Why is an authorization with no amount limit and no time limit required?
constants.hamonymsServiceFeeIsCalculated: Hamonym's service fee is calculated as a percentage of the activity on the platform, so the charge amount varies with the volume of activity and is not a fixed monthly amount. To allow ongoing collection, an authorization with no amount limit and no time limit must be set up. The actual charge is made only according to the terms of the agreement and the service fee agreed with the organization.
